frozen_library.rule: rows of the evaluated (task, init) are hidden; in-episode write-back of the case's own attempts is used

init_note: T0/T1/T7 grids used 0-39, pilots 40-41; T8 manner never run on 42-49 (step29 used them only for contact eval); T6 grids cover 0-49 so same-scene rows are hidden

conditions.nolib: ablation: no library rows (rule prior choice, cause-direction repair; S30_NOLIB=1)
conditions.no_repair: derived: first execution of 'full' (no extra run)

primary_metric: joint pass = every manner clause in band AND task success AND contact_policy_v1.1 clean_v1, after <= 3 executions
secondary_metrics: executions per case and per success
paired ordering on same (task, init): hold(gentle_X) < hold(firm_X) on X; carry speed slowcarry_X < neutral < fastcarry_X
binding correctness: Xgentle_Yfirm vs Xfirm_Ygentle hold order swaps between objects
stop reasons (manner vs non-manner), counted not hidden
statistics: paired McNemar (full vs nolib, final joint pass) over the 440 matched cases; Wilson 95% CI per rate
